intent: Evaluate whether a Work Unit has the required evidence, QA, review, audit and acceptance prerequisites for its current risk level and Definition of Done.
steps: Read the Work Unit, Test Strategy, Definition of Done and evidence objects
Require one exact candidate commit SHA for the evaluated state
Check that required verification is linked to concrete results and the evaluated code revision, not merely claimed
Mark QA, review, security or audit checks as stale when the current SHA differs from the SHA referenced by their evidence
Reject a work-in-progress commit as satisfying Definition of Done
Report satisfied checks, missing checks, failed checks, and critical blockers, defects or findings
State whether the Work Unit may transition to the next state
Do not mark human acceptance complete unless an explicit human result exists
invariants: Evidence must reference an exact evaluated revision
Do not accept self-reported completion without linked evidence
Human acceptance requires an explicit human result
